build_melody_conditioner: build a MelodyConditioner to project pre-computed melody salience matrices into embedding space for Jasco models
build_chords_conditioner: build a ChordsEmbConditioner to embed chord symbols into a continuous vector space using nn.Embedding
build_drums_conditioner: build a DrumsConditioner to extract drum stems via Demucs and encode them into coarse latent codes
build_jasco_conditioning_provider: build a JascoConditioningProvider to collate and tokenize symbolic chord and melody conditions for a batch
review_temporal_blur: review the DrumsConditioner _temporal_blur method that averages and repeats latent frames by a blurring factor
